name: Changed proposals, changed review records, and moved HEAD cannot be accepted
description: Changed proposals, changed review records, and moved HEAD cannot be accepted.

passage.quote: Before committing, acceptance checks that HEAD is still the recorded base and that the proposed files, including the generated review, still produce the pinned final tree. It requires a checked-out branch, rejects unfinished merge or rebase operations, and checks structural validity again. The completed tests and semantic investigation are reused; they are not rerun at this point.
